source.verification: Author checked hash/source/boundaries. Main independently verified all17 term/page matches, actual boundaries, cue economy and prior reuse. Vocabulary location only, not clinical or learning-effectiveness validation.

scope: Seventeen selected reusable vocabulary terms, not exhaustive coverage or quotas by topic. Offline associations only; no clinical anchors, lesson, narration, doses, mechanisms, current-guideline claims or image-generation prompts. New compositions combine familiar or previously recorded ingredients, not claims of novel invention.

source_wording_notes.bicarbonate: Exact word in Chapter15 introduction/right-column body on printed73; selected headword does not include sodium.
source_wording_notes.anion gap: Selected from THE ANION GAP heading printed73, not inferred from the abbreviation AG.
source_wording_notes.hyperkalemia: Table15-2 column heading printed76; actual noun, not inferred from hyperkalemic adjective.
source_wording_notes.hypokalemia: Table15-2 column heading printed76; actual noun, not inferred from hypokalemic adjective.
source_wording_notes.compensation: Exact word within respiratory compensation in Chapter15 body printed74; cue deliberately targets the generic compensation relationship, not a formula.

entries.cue: Conspicuous lemon used as the learned acid token.
entries.reason: Same acidosis cue, based on docs/visual-cue-catalog.json#acid-lemon. No pH, blood state, process-versus-state distinction or dietary cause encoded.

entries.cue: Recognizable bar of soap with a few soap bubbles.
entries.reason: Familiar soap/base association supplies a broad learned category contrast with lemon. Not a claim that every soap or cleanser has a particular pH, or a clinical definition or treatment. New chapter token, not novel chemistry or a new primitive invention claim.

entries.cue: Thick cushion visibly separating two toy carts at their point of contact.
entries.reason: Familiar physical buffer sense, not polish/buffing. No chemical reactions, specific substances, titration or physiologic buffering mechanism supplied.

entries.cue: Two simple minus-marked tokens separated by a conspicuous empty gap.
entries.prior: new_chapter_record; new composition of familiar sign and spacing
entries.reason: Simple taught identity/relationship token. Minus is a symbol, not an answer label or algebra; it does not depict the clinical calculation, measured or unmeasured quantities, a numerical threshold or a diagnostic pattern. Negative-symbol interpretation needs learned context.

entries.cue: Familiar orange baking-soda box with a small heap of white powder; no brand logo or answer label needed.
entries.reason: Preserves Chapter2/12 sodium-bicarbonate household cue and docs/visual-cue-catalog.json#bicarbonate-soda at the selected bicarbonate headword scope. No sodium qualifier silently added to source term, formulation, administration or chemical effect encoded.

entries.cue: Cracked egg with its translucent white separated into a small bowl.
entries.reason: Unchanged prior cue; not interchangeable biological substances, a buffer mechanism, dietary claim or treatment recommendation.

entries.cue: Familiar milk bottle beside a conspicuous lemon, neither pouring into nor changing the other.
entries.cue_scope: Lactic-name milk association plus established acid token
entries.prior: new_chapter_record; composition of prior chapter ingredients
entries.reason: Reuses milk from lactic acid in docs/chapter-12-cue-audit.json and lemon from docs/chapter-13-cue-audit.json. New compound composition, not a new primitive. Does not imply milk causes this condition, sour milk identity, an actual lactate molecule, metabolism or a clinical interpretation.

entries.cue: Kidney-shaped factory with conspicuously broken gears.
entries.reason: Preserves established cue also reused in Chapters6/7. No cause of acid-base disease, renal stage, test result or mechanism encoded.

No economical keto-name cue proposed. Do not force key/toe syllables or imply that a familiar diet image establishes the clinical target. Source subtype modifiers are not silently merged into a new lesson.

A gap alone supplies only the generic shared word and would collapse into the anion-gap cue without an osmolal identity ingredient. No strong simple ingredient proposed; no equation or toxicology shortcut authored.
Same user-inspired shared candidate already reused across chapters. No serum threshold, dietary causation, treatment or association with any other selected term encoded.

entries.cue: Nearly empty transparent container holding only a few banana tokens.
entries.reason: Existing low-potassium composition, not a new primitive. Match container and banana staging to the excess family; no laboratory value or dietary/treatment claim.

entries.cue: Recognizable bellows beside a conspicuous lemon.
entries.prior: new_chapter_record; new compound using catalog primitives
entries.reason: Reuses docs/visual-cue-catalog.json#respiration-bellows and #acid-lemon. No bellows rate, gas direction, ventilatory adequacy or clinical cause/effect is shown. Lesson context supplies the vocabulary sense.

entries.cue: Recognizable bellows beside a bar of soap with a few soap bubbles.
entries.cue_scope: Respiration token plus learned base token
entries.prior: new_chapter_record; paired composition using existing bellows and this bank's soap token
entries.reason: Uses the same bellows as respiratory acidosis, changing only the acid/base identity ingredient. Not breathing rate, a gas concentration, physiology, a diagnostic distinction or an intervention.

entries.cue: Intact generic factory with a recognizable conveyor belt beside a conspicuous lemon.
entries.cue_scope: Learned metabolic-processing factory plus acid token
entries.prior: new_chapter_record; new compound composition using existing acid token
entries.reason: Generic processing factory is an assigned metabolism category metaphor; lemon reuses the shared acid primitive. Factory is neither kidney-shaped nor broken, unlike renal failure. Not a metabolic pathway, causation, acid production or diagnosis claim. Familiar factory alone requires taught context.

entries.cue: Intact generic factory with a recognizable conveyor belt beside a bar of soap with a few soap bubbles.
entries.cue_scope: Same metabolic-processing factory plus learned base token
entries.prior: new_chapter_record; paired composition using this bank's factory and soap tokens
entries.reason: Preserves the metabolic family identity and changes only acid/base ingredient. New composition, not new primitives; no chemistry, physiologic mechanism, subtype criterion or treatment is inferred.

entries.cue: Counterweight visibly balancing a load on the opposite side of a simple balance scale.
entries.reason: Familiar compensation metaphor, not a physiologic response or an assertion that a disorder returns to normal. No ratios, expected values, formula or quantitative diagnostic model.
